levels.surface: الحسن بن عيسى بن محمد بن علي بن جعفر

notes: «حدثنا أبي» and «محمد بن الحسن» are co-transmitters (قالا marks the pair); «أبي» has no name in the text, so it is a relation
«عن جده محمد بن علي» is one link, the name alone (rule 7); Musa is named inside the chain after «أخيه», so he is a narrator and the saying is his
